Contents:
Field Trophy Notebook
by Jarek the Headcrusher.

I do not write legends or fairy tales. I write what is proven in practice:
hung up — felt it — remembered it.
If the scalp has no effect, then it is not the right head, not the right hook, or a better trophy of this type is already hanging.

I. Trolls

Attribute: heavy, coarse, smells of swamp/iron.
What it gives: a feeling that it is harder to pierce you with ordinary steel.
Varieties (in order of rarity and strength): Common Troll; Warrior Troll; Cave Troll.
Effect: When I missed a couple of “honest” hits in close combat (not magic, not fire) — the difference in the toughness of my skin is noticeably felt.

Note: if you already have a trophy of a stronger Troll, the weaker one will not manifest.

II. Minotaurs

Sign: horns/bony forehead, often with remnants of straps/marks.
What it gives: the feeling that your arms are heavier, while objects are lighter.
Variety: Minotaur with an axe; Wild Minotaur.
Effect: After obtaining the trophy, I felt that I could carry my things much more freely, and my strikes became much heavier.

Note: The head of a fighter and an ordinary bull are the same... What a nuisance.

III. Undersized Dragon

Feature: large, dry, elongated skull shape; scales/bony crests.
What it gives: the feeling that you notice details before they become a problem.
Effect: Reaction speed and accuracy noticeably increased... Even caught an arrow in mid-air.

Dragon

Feature: huge, has flecks of gold, fire-breathing; a trophy after which you want to fight more.
What it gives: your fighting passion lasts longer, and the recoil to the head is softer.
Effect: gauge by feel how long your “combat window” lasts and how quickly you are ready to repeat.
